# lokalise_team_user_group_member (Resource)

A single user's membership in a Lokalise team user group. This resource manages exactly the membership it created; it never removes any other member of the group. Creating it for a user who is already a member fails; import the existing membership instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lokalise_team_user" "jane" {
  team_id = 123456
  email   = "jane@example.com"
}

resource "lokalise_team_user_group" "french_translators" {
  team_id = 123456
  name    = "French translators"
  role_id = 5

  languages = {
    reference     = ["en"]
    contributable = ["fr"]
  }
}

resource "lokalise_team_user_group_member" "jane" {
  team_id  = 123456
  group_id = lokalise_team_user_group.french_translators.group_id
  user_id  = data.lokalise_team_user.jane.user_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (Number) Lokalise team user group ID. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `team_id` (Number) Lokalise team ID. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `user_id` (Number) Lokalise user ID to add to the group. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `team_id:group_id:user_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import lokalise_team_user_group_member.jane <team_id>:<group_id>:<user_id>
```
